answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can trade, with the stake slashed if peers prove duplicate or fraudulent attestations. A newcomer starts at the nadir of trust, earning reputation only through repeated, checkable work over time, so a Sybil farm must fund and age thousands of identities instead of spawning them free. Like a wharf that charges berthing fees per vessel, the protocol charges per identity in locked capital and time, while a single whisper of collusion triggers audits that can sink the whole fleet at once.
